about: The Workbench icons of the JumpnBump drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own 64x64 icon (dist/jumpnbump64.png). JumpnBump-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, JumpnBump.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's JumpnBump.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for README-jumpnbump, COPYING.txt and AUTHORS.
